aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but misgroups separate comparisons and includes invalid extracted measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed factor mixes Normal/no-bonding comparison with Yoke OK/NG swap comparison.
Baseline and changed condition are not consistently supported by cited rows.
Gauss evidence uses row 46 without visible source text and has suspect stats/violations.
Measurement-2 is derived from headers/defect counts, not a valid spec measurement.
Subgroup keys are promoted into the primary changed factor incorrectly.
correctionPlan: Split into distinct changed-factor contexts for no-bonding vs Normal and Yoke OK/NG swap.
Rebuild baseline/test labels from rows 18-23 and 47-52 only.
Re-extract and verify gauss/height rows before using measurement outcomes.
Keep line/date/type as subgroup context, not the primary factor unless evidenced.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist for function results, but measurement citations are insufficient and row 46 text must be verified.
